intent: Independently audit transfer04's observable evidence-record intervention before full-suite diagnostic execution.
author: /root

factors: Require an observable record of claim ownership, required target operation/relationship, actually supplied component, essential missing component and eligible outcome instead of a generic alignment conclusion
Increase only the top-level explanation allowance from 45 to 75 words
exact_change.unchanged: All evidence interpretation rules, state allowlists, transition precedence, event evidence types/quotes, output fields and per-event 25-word allowance remain identical to 03.

The 75-word allowance remains compatible with the contract's required nonempty brief overall explanation; parser/consumer behavior is unchanged.

af86353_NH03 credits another speaker's reported choice; one explanation explicitly acknowledges that attribution while still granting learner progress.

required_documentation: The inspected continuation-round03-20261015.md records the two changed factors, diagnostic hypothesis, unchanged evidence/consumer settings and full 118-case requirement.
